_meta.usage: Editorial content. 'today_partner' / 'today_self' = 1–2 lines for the "What's happening" card. 'tips_*' = tip bank: the Today screen picks 3 per day (deterministic by date, see IMPLEMENTATION.md). 'may_feel', 'helps', 'helps_less' = guide sheet. Tone: warm, concrete, never condescending, never medical. Written for English speakers, not a word-for-word translation.
_meta.disclaimer: Every cycle is different. Phases estimates; only she knows.

regles.name: Period
regles.subtitle: The cycle starts over. Energy is often low the first days.
regles.today_partner: Start of the cycle: tiredness and cramps or back pain are common, especially the first two days.
regles.today_self: Start of the cycle: tiredness and cramps are common, especially the first two days. Take it easy.

helps_less: Commenting on her mood or appetite
Sticking to a packed schedule no matter what

spm.today_self: Hormones are dropping: tiredness, irritability or cramps are common. Go easy on yourself.
